# Background and use

This notebook is used to create all tables and figures for this analysis.

The following notebooks should be run prior to running the present notebook:

-   1_data-import
-   1_PheWAS
-   2_PheWAS-sensitivity

# Setup

Install and load in necessary packages:

```{r}
install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
    jsonlite,
    table1,
    tidyverse,
    ggcorrplot,
    tidygraph,
    igraph,
    ggraph,
    irr,
    patchwork,
    ggVennDiagram,
    plotly,
    RColorBrewer,
    cvAUC,
    pROC,
    scales,
    ggrepel,
    UpSetR,
    ggtext,
    openxlsx,
    writexl
)
```

Define environmental variables:

```{r}
library(jsonlite)

wb <- function(...) fromJSON(system(paste("wb", ..., "--format=json"), intern = TRUE))

workspace <- wb("workspace describe")
GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT <- workspace$googleProjectId

resources <- wb("resource list")

# WORKSPACE_BUCKET
bucket_row <- resources[resources$resourceType == "GCS_BUCKET" &
                        grepl("workspace-bucket", resources$id) &
                        !grepl("temporary", resources$id), ]
WORKSPACE_BUCKET <- paste0("gs://", bucket_row$bucketName[1])

# WORKSPACE_CDR
bq <- resources[resources$resourceType %in% c("BQ_DATASET", "BIGQUERY_DATASET"), ]
cdr_row <- bq[grepl("^C\\d{4}Q\\d+R\\d+$", bq$datasetId), ]
WORKSPACE_CDR <- paste0(cdr_row$projectId[1], ".", cdr_row$datasetId[1])

# Summary
for (var in c("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT", "WORKSPACE_BUCKET", "WORKSPACE_CDR")) {
  val <- get(var)
  cat(var, ":", if (length(val) && nzchar(val)) val else "NOT FOUND", "\n")
}
```

Create combined dataframes for prevalent and incident associations:

```{r}

    mutate(logistic_year_steps, metric = "steps", time = "Year"),
    
    mutate(logistic_day_cadence1, metric = "cadence1", time = "Day"),

    mutate(logistic_month_cadence1, metric = "cadence1", time = "Month"),
    mutate(logistic_six_cadence1, metric = "cadence1", time = "Six months"),
```

Set variables that will be used:

```{r}
# Bonferroni corrections (note: could use any metric here, steps shown here)
alpha_logistic = 0.05 / nrow(logistic_day_steps)
alpha_cox_day = 0.05 / nrow(cox_day_steps)
alpha_cox_week = 0.05 / nrow(cox_week_steps)
alpha_cox_month = 0.05 / nrow(cox_month_steps)
alpha_cox_six = 0.05 / nrow(cox_six_steps)
alpha_cox_year = 0.05 / nrow(cox_year_steps)

periods  <- c("day", "week", "month", "six", "year")
metrics <- c("steps", "cadence1", "cadence30", "dhrps")
```

Pull the top 15 most significant phecodes from the logistic regression PheWAS results and the top 15 most significant phecodes from the cox regression PheWAS results:

*More specific phecodes replace less specific phecodes - e.g., if both Overweight and obesity (EM_236) and Obesity (EM_236.1) are in the top 15, EM_236.1 will be included over EM_236*

```{r}
logistic_phecodes <- logistic_combined %>%
    arrange(p_value) %>%
    distinct(phecode, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    pull(phecode)

keep_logistic <- character(0)

# Select 15 phecodes, but if a more specific phecode is added, remove the less specific one
for(i in seq_along(logistic_phecodes)) {
    if(length(keep_logistic) >= 15) break
    
    current <- logistic_phecodes[i]
    
    more_specific_check <- which(startsWith(current, keep_logistic) & nchar(current) > nchar(keep_logistic))
    
    if (length(more_specific_check) > 0) {
        keep_logistic <- keep_logistic[-more_specific_check]
        keep_logistic <- c(keep_logistic, current)
    } else {
        less_specific <- any(startsWith(keep_logistic, current) & nchar(keep_logistic) > nchar(current))
        
        if (!less_specific) {
            keep_logistic <- c(keep_logistic, current)
        }
    }
}

cox_phecodes <- cox_combined %>%
    arrange(p_value) %>%
    distinct(phecode, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    pull(phecode)

keep_cox <- character(0)

# Select 15 phecodes, but if a more specific phecode is added, remove the less specific one
for(i in seq_along(cox_phecodes)) {
    if(length(keep_cox) >= 15) break
    
    current <- cox_phecodes[i]
    
    more_specific_check <- which(startsWith(current, keep_cox) & nchar(current) > nchar(keep_cox))
    
    if (length(more_specific_check) > 0) {
        keep_cox <- keep_cox[-more_specific_check]
        keep_cox <- c(keep_cox, current)
    } else {
        less_specific <- any(startsWith(keep_cox, current) & nchar(keep_cox) > nchar(current))
        
        if (!less_specific) {
            keep_cox <- c(keep_cox, current)
        }
    }
}

# Filter to top associations
logistic_combined_top <- logistic_combined %>%
    filter(phecode %in% keep_logistic | phecode %in% keep_cox)

cox_combined_top <- cox_combined %>%
    filter(phecode %in% keep_cox | phecode %in% keep_logistic)

# Remove trailing * from phecode_string
logistic_combined_top <- logistic_combined_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_string = sub("\\*+$", "", phecode_string))

cox_combined_top <- cox_combined_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_string = sub("\\*+$", "", phecode_string))
```

### 2b Knowledge graph

```{r}
cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_matrix)) %>%
  rename(from = Var1, to = Var2, weight = Freq) %>%
  filter(from != to) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(from, to)), collapse = "_")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(from, to, weight)

cor_df$weight <- (abs(cor_df$weight))^2

nodes <- data.frame(name = unique(c(cor_df$from, cor_df$to))) %>%
  mutate(
    type = case_when(
      grepl("step count", name) ~ "Step count",
      grepl("1-min cadence", name) ~ "1-min cadence",
      grepl("30-min cadence", name) ~ "30-min cadence",
      grepl("DHRPS", name) ~ "DHRPS"
    ),
    period = case_when(
      grepl("six month", name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Six months",  # check before "month"
      grepl("day", name, ignore.case = TRUE)   ~ "Day",
      grepl("week", name, ignore.case = TRUE)  ~ "Week",
      grepl("month", name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Month",
      grepl("year", name, ignore.case = TRUE)  ~ "Year",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("Day", "Week", "Month", "Six months", "Year", "Other"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(period, name) %>%
  mutate(group_id = as.integer(period))

# Define circular layout
gap <- 0.15
n <- nrow(nodes)
n_groups <- n_distinct(nodes$group_id)
usable_angle <- 2 * pi - gap * n_groups

angles <- numeric(n)
current_angle <- 0
prev_group <- nodes$group_id[1]

for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  if (nodes$group_id[i] != prev_group) {
    current_angle <- current_angle + gap
    prev_group <- nodes$group_id[i]
  }
  angles[i] <- current_angle
  current_angle <- current_angle + (usable_angle / n)
}

nodes$angle <- angles
nodes$x <- cos(nodes$angle)
nodes$y <- sin(nodes$angle)

edges_plot <- cor_df %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("from" = "name")) %>%
  left_join(nodes, by = c("to" = "name"), suffix = c("", "_end")) %>%
  filter(weight > 0.4) # Only keep strong associations

knowledge <- ggplot() +
  geom_curve(
    data = edges_plot,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = x_end, yend = y_end,
        linewidth = weight, alpha = weight),
    color = "gray40",
    curvature = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = nodes,
    aes(x = x, y = y, color = type),
    size = 5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = nodes,
    aes(x = x * 1.12, y = y * 1.12, label = name),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.3, 3), name = "Similarity Strength") +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.2, 0.95), guide = "none") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Metric") +
  coord_equal(clip = "off") +
  xlim(-1.4, 1.4) + ylim(-1.4, 1.4) +
  theme_void()

knowledge
```

```{r}
png("~/workspace/Data from All of Us Controlled Tier /workspace-bucket/tabfig/knowledge.png", width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 400)
knowledge
dev.off()
```

### 2c - ICC plots

Calculate ICC for each metric:

```{r}
# Step count
icc_values_steps <- sapply(1:60, function(J) {
  message(sprintf("Computing ICC for J = %d", J))
  result <- compute_icc(df, J = J, metric = sum_steps, seed = 1000 + J)
  message(sprintf("Finished J = %d", J))
  result
})

icc_results_steps <- data.frame(J = 1:60, ICC = icc_values_steps)

saveRDS(icc_results_steps, "icc_results_steps.rds")
system2("gcloud",
        args = c("storage", "cp", "icc_results_steps.rds", paste0(WORKSPACE_BUCKET, "/icc_results/")),
        stdout = TRUE,
        stderr = TRUE)

# Peak 1-min cadence
icc_values_cadence1 <- sapply(1:60, function(J) {
  message(sprintf("Computing ICC for J = %d", J))
  result <- compute_icc(df, J = J, metric = peak_min_cadence, seed = 1000 + J)
  message(sprintf("Finished J = %d", J))
  result
})

icc_results_cadence1 <- data.frame(J = 1:60, ICC = icc_values_cadence1)

saveRDS(icc_results_cadence1, "icc_results_cadence1.rds")
system2("gcloud",
        args = c("storage", "cp", "icc_results_cadence1.rds", paste0(WORKSPACE_BUCKET, "/icc_results/")),
        stdout = TRUE,
        stderr = TRUE)

# Peak 30-min cadence
icc_values_cadence30 <- sapply(1:60, function(J) {
  message(sprintf("Computing ICC for J = %d", J))
  result <- compute_icc(df, J = J, metric = mean_peak_30_min_cadence, seed = 1000 + J)
  message(sprintf("Finished J = %d", J))
  result
})

icc_results_cadence30 <- data.frame(J = 1:60, ICC = icc_values_cadence30)

saveRDS(icc_results_cadence30, "icc_results_cadence30.rds")
system2("gcloud",
        args = c("storage", "cp", "icc_results_cadence30.rds", paste0(WORKSPACE_BUCKET, "/icc_results/")),
        stdout = TRUE,
        stderr = TRUE)

# Daily heart rate per step
icc_values_dhrps <- sapply(1:60, function(J) {
  message(sprintf("Computing ICC for J = %d", J))
  result <- compute_icc(df, J = J, metric = dhrps, seed = 1000 + J)
  message(sprintf("Finished J = %d", J))
  result
})

icc_results_dhrps <- data.frame(J = 1:60, ICC = icc_values_dhrps)

saveRDS(icc_results_dhrps, "icc_results_dhrps.rds")
system2("gcloud",
        args = c("storage", "cp", "icc_results_dhrps.rds", paste0(WORKSPACE_BUCKET, "/icc_results/")),
        stdout = TRUE,
        stderr = TRUE)
```

Combine into one plot:

```{r}
common_y_limits <- c(0, 1)

icc_steps     <- icc_steps     + coord_cartesian(ylim = common_y_limits)
icc_cadence1  <- icc_cadence1  + coord_cartesian(ylim = common_y_limits)
icc_cadence30 <- icc_cadence30 + coord_cartesian(ylim = common_y_limits)
icc_dhrps     <- icc_dhrps     + coord_cartesian(ylim = common_y_limits)

theme_no_y <- theme(
  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
  axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
)

icc_cadence1  <- icc_cadence1  + theme_no_y
icc_cadence30 <- icc_cadence30 + theme_no_y
icc_dhrps     <- icc_dhrps     + theme_no_y

icc <- (
  icc_steps + icc_cadence1 + icc_cadence30 + icc_dhrps
) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 4, guides = "collect")

icc
```

```{r}
icc_block <- wrap_elements(full = icc)  # treat ICC (4-panel) as one plot
```

## Supplementary Figure 3 - Sankey diagrams

```{r}
sankeys <- vector("list", length(metrics))
names(sankeys) <- metrics

for (m in metrics) {
  day   <- paste0("day_",   m, "_q")
  week  <- paste0("week_",  m, "_q")
  month <- paste0("month_", m, "_q")
  six   <- paste0("six_",   m, "_q")
  year  <- paste0("year_",  m, "_q")

  df_per_pid_sankey <- df_per_pid %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[day]]),
           !is.na(.data[[week]]),
           !is.na(.data[[month]]),
           !is.na(.data[[six]]),
           !is.na(.data[[year]]))

  transitions <- bind_rows(
    df_per_pid_sankey %>% count(source = paste0("day_Q",          .data[[day]]),
                        target = paste0("week_Q",         .data[[week]]),  name = "n"),
    df_per_pid_sankey %>% count(source = paste0("week_Q",         .data[[week]]),
                        target = paste0("month_Q",        .data[[month]]), name = "n"),
    df_per_pid_sankey %>% count(source = paste0("month_Q",        .data[[month]]),
                        target = paste0("six_months_Q",   .data[[six]]),   name = "n"),
    df_per_pid_sankey %>% count(source = paste0("six_months_Q",   .data[[six]]),
                        target = paste0("year_Q",         .data[[year]]),  name = "n")
  )

  nodes <- data.frame(name = unique(c(transitions$source, transitions$target)))
  nodes$index <- 0:(nrow(nodes) - 1)

  transitions <- transitions %>%
    left_join(nodes, by = c("source" = "name")) %>%
    rename(source_id = index) %>%
    left_join(nodes, by = c("target" = "name")) %>%
    rename(target_id = index)

  palette <- brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "BuPu")
  node_colors <- rep(palette, length.out = nrow(nodes))

  sankeys[[m]] <- plot_ly(
    type = "sankey",
    orientation = "h",
    node = list(
      label = nodes$name,
      pad = 15,
      thickness = 20,
      font = list(size = 5),
      color = node_colors
    ),
    link = list(
      source = transitions$source_id,
      target = transitions$target_id,
      value = transitions$n
    )
  )
}

sankeys$steps
sankeys$cadence1
sankeys$cadence30
sankeys$dhrps
```

## Figure 2

### 2a - Volcano plot (step count)

```{r}
# Save dataframe for volcano plot
volcano <- logistic_combined %>%
  filter(metric == "steps", time == "Year") %>%
  select(phecode_string, odds_ratio, p_value, phecode_category) %>%
  mutate(
    logp = -log10(p_value),
    sig  = p_value < alpha_logistic
  )

# Select phecodes to label
top_neg <- volcano %>%
  filter(odds_ratio < 1) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15)

top_pos <- volcano %>%
  filter(odds_ratio > 1) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  slice_head(n = 2)

novel_labels <- c(
  "Asthma",
  "Headache",
  "Asphyxia and hypoxemia",
  "Chronic pain syndrome",
  "Disorders of autonomic nervous system",
  "Benign neoplasm of the skin"
)

novel_df <- volcano %>%
  filter(phecode_string %in% novel_labels)

label_df <- bind_rows(top_neg, top_pos, novel_df) %>%
  distinct(phecode_string, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Plot
steps_volcano <- ggplot(volcano, aes(x = odds_ratio, y = logp, color = phecode_category)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#FBE183",
                                   "#F4C40F",
                                   "#FE9B00",
                                   "#F97306",
                                   "#D8443C",
                                   "#9B3441",
                                   "#DE597C",
                                   "#E87B89",
                                   "#E6A2A6",
                                   "#AA7AA1",
                                   "#9F5691",
                                   "#633372",
                                   "#3B3B98",
                                   "#1F6E9C",
                                   "#2B9B81",
                                   "#2E8B57",
                                   "#92C051")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "solid") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(alpha_logistic), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_text_repel(
        data = label_df,
        aes(label = phecode_string),
        size = 5,
        max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    labs(
        x = "OR (per 1,000 step increase)",
        y = "-log10(p-value)",
        color = "Phecode category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

png("~/workspace/Data from All of Us Controlled Tier /workspace-bucket/tabfig/steps_volcano.png", width = 12, height = 10, units = "in", res = 400)

dev.off()
```

### 2b - Metric correlation plots

Pull the year association for each metric:

```{r}
steps_df <- logistic_combined %>%
  filter(metric == "steps", time == "Year") %>%
  select(phecode, or_steps = beta, p_steps = p_value)

cadence1_df <- logistic_combined %>%
  filter(metric == "cadence1", time == "Year") %>%
  select(phecode, or_cadence1 = beta, p_cadence1 = p_value)

cadence30_df <- logistic_combined %>%
  filter(metric == "cadence30", time == "Year") %>%
  select(phecode, or_cadence30 = beta, p_cadence30 = p_value)

dhrps_df <- logistic_combined %>%
  filter(metric == "dhrps", time == "Year") %>%
  select(phecode, or_dhrps = beta, p_dhrps = p_value)
```

Make scatterplots comparing step count to all other metrics:

```{r}
# steps x cadence1
steps_cadence1 <- steps_df %>%
  inner_join(cadence1_df, by = "phecode") %>%
  mutate(
    sig_category = factor(
      case_when(
        p_steps < alpha_logistic & p_cadence1 < alpha_logistic ~ "Both",
        p_steps < alpha_logistic                      ~ "Step count only",
        p_cadence1 < alpha_logistic                   ~ "Peak 1-min cadence only",
        TRUE                                 ~ "Neither"
      ),
      levels = c("Both", "Step count only", "Peak 1-min cadence only", "Neither")
    )
  )

r <- cor(steps_cadence1$or_steps, steps_cadence1$or_cadence1, use = "complete.obs")

steps_cadence1 <- ggplot(steps_cadence1, aes(x = or_steps, y = or_cadence1, color = sig_category)) +
geom_point(
  data = ~ subset(.x, sig_category == "Neither" | sig_category == "Both"),
  alpha = 0.5
) +
geom_point(
  data = ~ subset(.x, sig_category != "Neither" & sig_category != "Both"),
  alpha = 0.7
) +    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Both" = "black",
      "Step count only" = "#DE7A00FF",
      "Peak 1-min cadence only" = "#860A4DFF",
      "Neither" = "grey80"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "log(OR) - step count",
    y = "log(OR) - peak 1-min cadence",
    color = "Bonferroni significance",
    title = paste0("Correlation: r = ", round(r, 3))
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# steps x cadence30
steps_cadence30 <- steps_df %>%
  inner_join(cadence30_df, by = "phecode") %>%
  mutate(
    sig_category = factor(
      case_when(
        p_steps < alpha_logistic & p_cadence30 < alpha_logistic ~ "Both",

        TRUE                                 ~ "Neither"
      ),
      levels = c("Both", "Step count only", "Peak 30-min cadence only", "Neither")
    )
  )

r <- cor(steps_cadence30$or_steps, steps_cadence30$or_cadence30, use = "complete.obs")

steps_cadence30 <- ggplot(steps_cadence30, aes(x = or_steps, y = or_cadence30, color = sig_category)) +
geom_point(
  data = ~ subset(.x, sig_category == "Neither" | sig_category == "Both"),
  alpha = 0.5
) +
geom_point(
  data = ~ subset(.x, sig_category != "Neither" & sig_category != "Both"),
  alpha = 0.7
) +  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Both" = "black",
      "Step count only" = "#DE7A00FF",
      "Peak 30-min cadence only" = "#860A4DFF",
      "Neither" = "grey80"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "log(OR) - step count",

  theme_minimal() +

  )


# steps x dhrps
steps_dhrps <- steps_df %>%

  mutate(
```

### 3a - Forest plot (step count)

Make a list of novel phecodes (those not shown to be significant in prior studies) from the most significant phecodes:

```{r}
novel <- c(
    "Chronic pain syndrome",
    "Disorders of autonomic nervous system"
)
```

```{r}
# Define color palette
time_palette <- c(
  "Day" = "#f9c80e",
  "Week" = "#f86624",
  "Month" = "#156082",
  "Six months" = "#43bccd",
  "Year" = "#662e9b"
)

# Create phecode label to note novel associations - novel phecodes bolded using markdown
logistic_combined_top <- logistic_combined_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_label = if_else(
        phecode_string %in% novel,
        paste0("**", phecode_string, "**"),
        phecode_string
    )
)

cox_combined_top <- cox_combined_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_label = if_else(
        phecode_string %in% novel,
        paste0("**", phecode_string, "**"),
        phecode_string
    )
)

# Define phecode ordering
logistic_phecode_order <- logistic_combined_top %>%
    group_by(phecode_label) %>%
    summarize(order_val = min(odds_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(order_val) %>%
    pull(phecode_label)

logistic_combined_top <- logistic_combined_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_label = factor(phecode_label, levels = logistic_phecode_order))

cox_phecode_order <- cox_combined_top %>%
    group_by(phecode_label) %>%
    summarize(order_val = min(hazard_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    arrange(order_val) %>%
    pull(phecode_label)

cox_combined_top <- cox_combined_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_label = factor(phecode_label, levels = cox_phecode_order))

# Create forest plots

## Step count - prevalent   
fp_logistic_steps <- ggplot(data = logistic_combined_top %>% filter(metric == "steps"), aes(x = odds_ratio, y = phecode_label, color = time)) +
    # Plotting
    geom_point(shape = 15, size = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = exp(conf_int_1), xmax = exp(conf_int_2)), height = 0, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1) +

    # Aesthetics
    guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(0.65, 1.05)) +
    labs(title = "Prevalent associations", x = "OR (per 1,000 steps higher)", y = NULL, color = "Time window") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(values = time_palette) +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 8),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
    )
    
## Step count - incident

    labs(title = "Incident associations", x = "HR (per 1,000 steps higher)", y = NULL, color = "Time window") +
```

### 3b - Bonferroni count plot

```{r}
# Bonferroni count using # rows as # tests
bonferroni_count <- function(df, pcol = "p_value", alpha = 0.05) {
  if (!pcol %in% names(df)) stop("Column '", pcol, "' not found in df.")
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(0L)
  thresh <- alpha / nrow(df)
  sum(df[[pcol]] < thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Set column order
column_labels <- c(paste0("Logistic regression-", metrics), paste0("Cox regression-", metrics))

# Create blank matrix
res <- matrix(NA_integer_,
              nrow = length(periods),
              ncol = length(column_labels),
              dimnames = list(periods, column_labels))

# Fill in for each metric-period combination
for (i in seq_along(periods)) {
  per <- periods[i]
  col_idx <- 1
  
  # All LR columns
  for (m in metrics) {
    obj_name <- paste("logistic", per, m, sep = "_")  # e.g., "logistic_day_steps"
    if (!exists(obj_name, inherits = TRUE)) stop("Data frame '", obj_name, "' not found.")
    res[i, col_idx] <- bonferroni_count(get(obj_name), pcol = "p_value", alpha = 0.05)
    col_idx <- col_idx + 1
  }
  
  # All Cox columns
  for (m in metrics) {
    obj_name <- paste("cox", per, m, sep = "_") # e.g., "cox_day_steps"
    if (!exists(obj_name, inherits = TRUE)) stop("Data frame '", obj_name, "' not found.")
    res[i, col_idx] <- bonferroni_count(get(obj_name), pcol = "p_value", alpha = 0.05)
    col_idx <- col_idx + 1
  }
}

bonferroni_summary <- as.data.frame(res, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# View the table
bonferroni_summary
```

```{r}
# Convert rownames to a column
bonferroni_summary <- bonferroni_summary %>%
  mutate(Period = rownames(bonferroni_summary))

# Long format
df_bonferroni_long <- bonferroni_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Period,
    names_to = "VariableModel",
    values_to = "SigCount"
  ) %>%
  separate(VariableModel, into = c("Model", "Variable"), sep = "-", remove = FALSE)

# Order Period
df_bonferroni_long$Variable <- factor(df_bonferroni_long$Variable,
                           levels = c("steps", "cadence1", "cadence30", "dhrps"))

df_bonferroni_long$Period <- factor(df_bonferroni_long$Period,
                         levels = c("day", "week", "month", "six", "year"),
                         labels = c("Day", "Week", "Month", "Six Months", "Year"))

df_bonferroni_long$Model <- factor(df_bonferroni_long$Model,
                        levels = c("Logistic regression", "Cox regression"),
                        labels = c("Prevalent associations", "Incident associations"))

# Plot: same color for same variable, different linetype for model
bonferroni <- ggplot(df_bonferroni_long, aes(x = Period, 
                                  y = SigCount,
                                  group = interaction(Variable, Model),
                                  color = Variable, linetype = Model)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    labs(x = "Time window",
       y = "Number of Bonferroni-significant outcomes",
       group = "Model",
       color = "Metric") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
            "#1170AAFF",
            "#57606CFF",
            "#A3CCE9FF",
            "#FC7D0BFF"
        ),
        labels = c(
            "Step count",
            "Peak 1-min cadence",
            "Peak 30-min cadence",
            "Daily heart rate per step"
        )
    )
```

```{r}
# Heatmap - step count - prevalent
logistic_time_comparisons_steps <- logistic_combined_top %>%
    filter(metric == "steps") %>%
    pivot_wider(
        id_cols = phecode_string,
        names_from = time,
        values_from = c(beta, standard_error)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        # Day v week
        day_week_z = (beta_Day - beta_Week) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + standard_error_Week^2),
        day_week_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_week_z)),

        # Day v month
        day_month_z = (beta_Day - beta_Month) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + standard_error_Month^2),
        day_month_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_month_z)),

        # Day v six months
        day_six_z = (beta_Day - `beta_Six months`) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + `standard_error_Six months`^2),
        day_six_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_six_z)),

        # Day v year
        day_year_z = (beta_Day - beta_Year) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + standard_error_Year^2),
        day_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_year_z)),

        # Week v month
        week_month_z = (beta_Week - beta_Month) / sqrt(standard_error_Week^2 + standard_error_Month^2),
        week_month_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(week_month_z)),

        # Week v six months
        week_six_z = (beta_Week - `beta_Six months`) / sqrt(standard_error_Week^2 + `standard_error_Six months`^2),
        week_six_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(week_six_z)),

        # Week v year
        week_year_z = (beta_Week - beta_Year) / sqrt(standard_error_Week^2 + standard_error_Year^2),
        week_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(week_year_z)),

        # Month v six months
        month_six_z = (beta_Month - `beta_Six months`) / sqrt(standard_error_Month^2 + `standard_error_Six months`^2),
        month_six_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(month_six_z)),

        # Month v year
        month_year_z = (beta_Month - beta_Year) / sqrt(standard_error_Month^2 + standard_error_Year^2),
        month_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(month_year_z)),

        # Six months v year
        six_year_z = (`beta_Six months` - beta_Year) / sqrt(`standard_error_Six months`^2 + standard_error_Year^2),
        six_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(six_year_z))
    )

df_heatmap_logistic_steps <- logistic_time_comparisons_steps %>%
    select(phecode_string, ends_with("_p")) %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = -phecode_string,
        names_to = "comparison",
        values_to = "p"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        comparison = recode(
            comparison,
            day_week_p   = "Day vs Week",
            day_month_p  = "Day vs Month",
            day_six_p    = "Day vs Six months",
            day_year_p   = "Day vs Year",
            week_month_p = "Week vs Month",

            week_year_p  = "Week vs Year",
            month_six_p  = "Month vs Six months",
            month_year_p = "Month vs Year",
            six_year_p   = "Six months vs Year"
        ),
        comparison = factor(
            comparison,
            levels = c(
                "Day vs Week",
                "Day vs Month",
                "Day vs Six months",
                "Day vs Year",
                "Week vs Month",
                "Week vs Six months",
                "Week vs Year",
                "Month vs Six months",
                "Month vs Year",
                "Six months vs Year"
            )
        ),
        neglog10p = -log10(p)
    )

heatmap_logistic_steps <- ggplot(df_heatmap_logistic_steps,
       aes(x = comparison, y = phecode_string, fill = neglog10p)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#D5D5D5", high = "#49525E", na.value = "grey90", limits = c(0, 20)) +

# Heatmap - step count - incident
cox_time_comparisons_steps <- cox_combined_top %>%
    filter(metric == "steps") %>%
    pivot_wider(
        id_cols = phecode_string,
        names_from = time,
        values_from = c(log_hazard_ratio, standard_error)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        # Day v week
        day_week_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Day - log_hazard_ratio_Week) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + standard_error_Week^2),
        day_week_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_week_z)),

        # Day v month
        day_month_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Day - log_hazard_ratio_Month) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + standard_error_Month^2),
        day_month_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_month_z)),

        # Day v six months
        day_six_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Day - `log_hazard_ratio_Six months`) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + `standard_error_Six months`^2),
        day_six_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_six_z)),

        # Day v year
        day_year_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Day - log_hazard_ratio_Year) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + standard_error_Year^2),
        day_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_year_z)),

        # Week v month
        week_month_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Week - log_hazard_ratio_Month) / sqrt(standard_error_Week^2 + standard_error_Month^2),
        week_month_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(week_month_z)),

        # Week v six months
        week_six_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Week - `log_hazard_ratio_Six months`) / sqrt(standard_error_Week^2 + `standard_error_Six months`^2),
        week_six_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(week_six_z)),

        # Week v year
        week_year_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Week - log_hazard_ratio_Year) / sqrt(standard_error_Week^2 + standard_error_Year^2),
        week_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(week_year_z)),

        # Month v six months
        month_six_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Month - `log_hazard_ratio_Six months`) / sqrt(standard_error_Month^2 + `standard_error_Six months`^2),
        month_six_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(month_six_z)),

        # Month v year
        month_year_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Month - log_hazard_ratio_Year) / sqrt(standard_error_Month^2 + standard_error_Year^2),
        month_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(month_year_z)),

        # Six months v year
        six_year_z = (`log_hazard_ratio_Six months` - log_hazard_ratio_Year) / sqrt(`standard_error_Six months`^2 + standard_error_Year^2),
        six_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(six_year_z))
    )

df_heatmap_cox_steps <- cox_time_comparisons_steps %>%
    select(phecode_string, ends_with("_p")) %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = -phecode_string,
        names_to = "comparison",
        values_to = "p"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        comparison = recode(
            comparison,
            day_week_p   = "Day vs Week",
            day_month_p  = "Day vs Month",
            day_six_p    = "Day vs Six months",
            day_year_p   = "Day vs Year",
            week_month_p = "Week vs Month",
            week_six_p   = "Week vs Six months",
            week_year_p  = "Week vs Year",
            month_six_p  = "Month vs Six months",
            month_year_p = "Month vs Year",
            six_year_p   = "Six months vs Year"
        ),
        comparison = factor(
            comparison,
            levels = c(
                "Day vs Week",
                "Day vs Month",
                "Day vs Six months",
                "Day vs Year",
                "Week vs Month",
                "Week vs Six months",
                "Week vs Year",
                "Month vs Six months",
                "Month vs Year",
                "Six months vs Year"
            )
        ),
        neglog10p = -log10(p)
    )

heatmap_cox_steps <- ggplot(df_heatmap_cox_steps,
       aes(x = comparison, y = phecode_string, fill = neglog10p)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#D5D5D5", high = "#49525E", na.value = "grey90", limits = c(0, 20)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = expression("Z-score " * -log[10](p))) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8)
    )
```

```{r}
fp_heat_steps <- fp_logistic_steps + heatmap_logistic_steps + fp_cox_steps + heatmap_cox_steps +
  plot_layout(
    ncol = 4,
    widths = c(1.5, 1, 1.5, 1),
     guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
fp_heat_steps

dev.off()
```

```{r}
        day_month_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Day - log_hazard_ratio_Month) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + standard_error_Month^2),
        day_month_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_month_z)),

        # Day v six months

        day_six_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_six_z)),

        # Day v year
        day_year_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Day - log_hazard_ratio_Year) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + standard_error_Year^2),
        day_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_year_z)),

        # Week v month
        week_month_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Week - log_hazard_ratio_Month) / sqrt(standard_error_Week^2 + standard_error_Month^2),
        week_month_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(week_month_z)),

        # Week v six months

        week_six_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(week_six_z)),

        # Week v year
        week_year_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Week - log_hazard_ratio_Year) / sqrt(standard_error_Week^2 + standard_error_Year^2),
        week_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(week_year_z)),

        # Month v six months
        month_six_z = (log_hazard_ratio_Month - `log_hazard_ratio_Six months`) / sqrt(standard_error_Month^2 + `standard_error_Six months`^2),
        month_six_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(month_six_z)),

        # Month v year

        month_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(month_year_z)),
```

```{r}
        names_from = time,
        values_from = c(beta, standard_error)

    mutate(
        # Day v week

        day_week_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_week_z)),

        # Day v month
        day_month_z = (beta_Day - beta_Month) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + standard_error_Month^2),
        day_month_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_month_z)),

        day_six_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_six_z)),

        # Day v year
        day_year_z = (beta_Day - beta_Year) / sqrt(standard_error_Day^2 + standard_error_Year^2),
        day_year_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(day_year_z)),

        # Week v month
        week_month_z = (beta_Week - beta_Month) / sqrt(standard_error_Week^2 + standard_error_Month^2),
        week_month_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(week_month_z)),
```

```{r}
# Pull Bonferroni-significant phecodes for each dataframe
get_bonf_list <- function(df, alpha = 0.05) {
  thr <- alpha / n_distinct(df$phecode)
  df %>%
    filter(p_value <= thr) %>%
    distinct(phecode) %>%
    pull(phecode)
}
```

## Figure 4 - HR vs OR (step count)

```{r}
# Merge logistic regression and Cox regression results using the year time period
merged_year_steps <- merge(logistic_year_steps, cox_year_steps, by = "phecode", suffixes = c("_logistic", "_cox"))

merged_year_steps <- merged_year_steps %>%
    mutate(
        sig_category = factor(
            case_when(
                p_value_logistic < alpha_logistic & p_value_cox < alpha_cox_year ~ "Both prevalent and incident",
                p_value_logistic < alpha_logistic & !(p_value_cox < alpha_cox_year) ~ "Prevalent only",
                !(p_value_logistic < alpha_logistic) & p_value_cox < alpha_cox_year ~ "Incident only",
                TRUE ~ "Neither"
            ),
            levels = c(
                "Both prevalent and incident",
                "Prevalent only",
                "Incident only",
                "Neither"
            )
        )
    )

# Create a list of phecodes to label
phecode_list <- c(
    "Actinic keratosis",
    "Acute kidney failure",
    "Acute respiratory failure",
    "Allergy",
    "Anemia",
    "Atherosclerosis [ASCVD]",
    "Atrial fibrillation",
    "Autoimmune disease",
    "Chronic fatigue syndrome",
    "Chronic kidney disease",
    "Chronic migraine without aura",
    "Chronic nonalcoholic liver disease",
    "Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease [COPD]",
    "Chronic pain syndrome",
    "Deep vein thrombosis [DVT]",
    "Diastolic heart failure",
    "Difficulty walking",
    "Disorders of autonomic nervous system",
    "Gallstones [Cholelithiasis]",
    "Gastro-esophageal reflux disease [GERD]",
    "Heart failure",
    "Heart valve replaced",
    "Hyperlipidemia",
    "Hypertension",
    "Ischemic heart disease",
    "Kidney stone disease",
    "Major depressive disorder",
    "Mild cognitive impairment",
    "Mood [affective] disorders",
    "Myocardial infarction [Heart attack]",
    "Obesity",
    "Obstructive sleep apnea",
    "Osteoarthritis",
    "Pain in hip",
    "Pain in knee",
    "Presence of cardiac device",
    "Proteinuria",
    "Renal failure",
    "Rheumatoid arthritis",
    "Skin changes due to solar radiation",
    "Stroke",
    "Type 2 diabetes",
    "Vitamin deficiencies"
)

labels <- merged_year_steps %>%
    filter(phecode_string_cox %in% phecode_list)

# Plot
steps_or_hr_plot <- ggplot(merged_year_steps, aes(x = hazard_ratio, y = odds_ratio)) +
    geom_point(
        data = subset(merged_year_steps, sig_category == "Neither"),
        aes(size = cases_logistic + cases_cox),
        color = "grey90", alpha = 0.8, shape = 16) +
    geom_point(
        data = subset(merged_year_steps, sig_category != "Neither"),
        aes(color = sig_category, size = cases_logistic + cases_cox),
        alpha = 0.8, shape = 16) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_label_repel(
        data = labels,
        aes(label = phecode_string_cox, color = sig_category),
            size = 2.5,
            box.padding  = grid::unit(0.35, "lines"),
            point.padding = grid::unit(0.2, "lines"),
            label.padding = grid::unit(0.12, "lines"),
            label.size = 0,
            fill = "white",
            alpha = 0.9,
            max.overlaps = Inf,
            force = 6,
            force_pull = 0.4,
            min.segment.length = 0,
            segment.curvature = 0.1,
            segment.ncp = 3,
            segment.angle = 20,
            show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(
        values = c("Both prevalent and incident" = "#000000",
                   "Prevalent only" = "#2D6A9F",
                   "Incident only" = "#EE8636"),
        name = "Bonferroni significance") +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 4, name = "Number of cases") +
    labs(
        x = "Hazard ratio (per 1000 step higher)",
        y = "Odds ratio (per 1000 step higher)"
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.97, y = 0.82,
             label = "Biomarker-like\n|log(OR)| > |log(HR)|",
             hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = 0.7, y = 0.96,
             label = "Risk factor-like\n|log(HR)| > |log(OR)|",
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3.5, color = "black")
```


### Step count

```{r}
# Combine all sensitivity analyses into one dataframe
sensitivity_cox <- bind_rows(
    mutate(cox_year_steps, analysis = "Main"),
    mutate(cox_year_steps_bmi, analysis = "BMI"),
    mutate(cox_year_steps_washout, analysis = "Washout"),
    mutate(cox_year_steps_one, analysis = "One year Fitbit"),
    mutate(cox_year_steps_three, analysis = "First three years excluded")
) %>%
    mutate(analysis = factor(analysis, levels = c("Main",
                                                  "BMI",
                                                  "Washout",
                                                  "One year Fitbit",
                                                  "First three years excluded")
                            )
          )

sensitivity_logistic <- bind_rows(
    mutate(logistic_year_steps, analysis = "Main"),
    mutate(logistic_year_steps_bmi, analysis = "BMI"),
    mutate(logistic_year_steps_washout, analysis = "Washout"),
    mutate(logistic_year_steps_one, analysis = "One year Fitbit"),
    mutate(logistic_year_steps_three, analysis = "First three years excluded")
) %>%
    mutate(analysis = factor(analysis, levels = c("Main",
                                                  "BMI",
                                                  "Washout",
                                                  "One year Fitbit",
                                                  "First three years excluded")
                            )
          ) 

# Filter to top associations
sensitivity_logistic_top <- sensitivity_logistic %>%
    filter(phecode %in% keep_logistic | phecode %in% keep_cox)

sensitivity_cox_top <- sensitivity_cox %>%
    filter(phecode %in% keep_cox | phecode %in% keep_logistic)

# Remove trailing * from phecode_string
sensitivity_logistic_top <- sensitivity_logistic_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_string = sub("\\*+$", "", phecode_string))

sensitivity_cox_top <- sensitivity_cox_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_string = sub("\\*+$", "", phecode_string))

# Define color palette
sens_palette <- c(
  "Main" = "black", "BMI" = "#798861", "Washout" = "#A8BDB5",
  "One year Fitbit" = "#8DA4BE", "First three years excluded" = "#A0C6DC"
)


# Create phecode label to note novel associations - novel phecodes bolded using markdown
sensitivity_logistic_top <- sensitivity_logistic_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_label = if_else(
        phecode_string %in% novel,
        paste0("**", phecode_string, "**"),
        phecode_string
    )
)

sensitivity_cox_top <- sensitivity_cox_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_label = if_else(
        phecode_string %in% novel,
        paste0("**", phecode_string, "**"),
        phecode_string
    )
)

# Define phecode ordering
sensitivity_logistic_top <- sensitivity_logistic_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_label = factor(phecode_label, levels = logistic_phecode_order))

sensitivity_cox_top <- sensitivity_cox_top %>%
    mutate(phecode_label = factor(phecode_label, levels = cox_phecode_order))

# Create forest plots

## Step count - prevalent   
fp_logistic_steps_sens <- ggplot(sensitivity_logistic_top, aes(x = odds_ratio, y = phecode_label, color = analysis)) +
    # Plotting
    geom_point(shape = 15, size = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = exp(conf_int_1), xmax = exp(conf_int_2)), height = 0, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1) +

    # Aesthetics
    guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(0.65, 1.05)) +
    labs(title = "Prevalent associations", x = "OR (per 1,000 steps higher)", y = NULL, color = "Sensitivity analysis") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(values = sens_palette) +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
    )
    
## Step count - incident   
fp_cox_steps_sens <- ggplot(sensitivity_cox_top, aes(x = hazard_ratio, y = phecode_label, color = analysis)) +
    # Plotting
    geom_point(shape = 15, size = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = hazard_ratio_low, xmax = hazard_ratio_high), height = 0, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1) +

    # Aesthetics
    guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(0.65, 1.05)) +
    labs(title = "Incident associations", x = "HR (per 1,000 steps higher)", y = NULL, color = "Sensitivity analysis") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(values = sens_palette) +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
    )
```

```{r}
sens_plot_steps <-
    (fp_logistic_steps_sens + fp_cox_steps_sens) +
    plot_layout(
        ncol = 2,
        guides = "collect",
        axes = "collect"
    )
```

```{r}
sens_plot_steps

png("~/workspace/Data from All of Us Controlled Tier /workspace-bucket/tabfig/sens_plot_steps.png", width = 11, height = 11, units = "in", res = 400)
sens_plot_steps
dev.off()
```

```{r}
        axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
    )
    
## Daily heart rate per step - incident   
fp_cox_dhrps_sens <- ggplot(sensitivity_cox_top, aes(x = hazard_ratio, y = phecode_label, color = analysis)) +
    # Plotting
    geom_point(shape = 15, size = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = hazard_ratio_low, xmax = hazard_ratio_high), height = 0, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1) +

    # Aesthetics
    guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(0.8, 2.2)) +
    labs(title = "Incident associations", x = "HR (per 0.01 DHRPS higher)", y = NULL, color = "Sensitivity analysis") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_manual(values = sens_palette) +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(),
        axis.line.x = element_line(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
    )
```

## Supplementary Table 3 - Strength of correlations across activity metrics and time windows

```{r}
# --- Map each column to its metric group (suffix after " - ") ---
groups <- setNames(
  vapply(strsplit(colnames(cor_matrix), " - ", fixed = TRUE),
         function(parts) trimws(tail(parts, 1)), character(1)),
  colnames(cor_matrix)
)

# --- Map each column to its time horizon (prefix before " - ") ---
time_groups <- setNames(
  vapply(strsplit(colnames(cor_matrix), " - ", fixed = TRUE),
         function(parts) trimws(head(parts, 1)), character(1)),
  colnames(cor_matrix)
)

# Work with absolute correlations
acor <- abs(cor_matrix)

# --- Helpers ---
upper_vals <- function(mat) {
  mat[upper.tri(mat, diag = FALSE)]
}

corr_subset <- function(mat, group_a, group_b, groups_map) {
  idx_a <- names(groups_map)[groups_map == group_a]
  idx_b <- names(groups_map)[groups_map == group_b]
  if (length(idx_a) == 0 || length(idx_b) == 0) return(numeric(0))

  if (group_a == group_b) {
    subm <- mat[idx_a, idx_a, drop = FALSE]
    vals <- upper_vals(subm)
  } else {
    subm <- mat[idx_a, idx_b, drop = FALSE]
    vals <- as.vector(subm)
  }
  as.numeric(vals)
}

# A vs "all others" based on metric groups
corr_vs_others <- function(mat, group_a, groups_map) {
  idx_a <- names(groups_map)[groups_map == group_a]
  idx_other <- setdiff(colnames(mat), idx_a)
  if (length(idx_a) == 0 || length(idx_other) == 0) return(numeric(0))
  as.numeric(mat[idx_a, idx_other, drop = FALSE])
}

# Time horizon A vs "all other" horizons
time_vs_others <- function(mat, time_a, time_map) {
  idx_a <- names(time_map)[time_map == time_a]
  idx_other <- setdiff(colnames(mat), idx_a)
  if (length(idx_a) == 0 || length(idx_other) == 0) return(numeric(0))
  as.numeric(mat[idx_a, idx_other, drop = FALSE])
}

summ_median_iqr <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  qs <- as.numeric(quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f (", "%.", digits, "f–%.", digits, "f)"), qs[2], qs[1], qs[3])
}

# --- Metric group labels (must match suffixes in your colnames) ---
grp_step   <- "step count"
grp_cad1   <- "1-min cadence"
grp_cad30  <- "30-min cadence"
grp_dhrps  <- "DHRPS"

# --- Time horizon labels (must match prefixes in your colnames) ---
time_day   <- "Day"
time_week  <- "Week"
time_month <- "Month"
time_six   <- "Six Months"
time_year  <- "Year"

# --- Build comparison vectors (ALL USE ABS CORRELATIONS) ---
comparisons <- list(
  "All correlations"                                   = upper_vals(acor),

  # Within metric groups
  "Step count (within)"                                = corr_subset(acor, grp_step,  grp_step,  groups),
  "1-min cadence (within)"                             = corr_subset(acor, grp_cad1,  grp_cad1,  groups),
  "30-min cadence (within)"                            = corr_subset(acor, grp_cad30, grp_cad30, groups),
  "DHRPS (within)"                                     = corr_subset(acor, grp_dhrps, grp_dhrps, groups),

  # Between specific metric groups
  "Step–1-min cadence (between)"                       = corr_subset(acor, grp_step,  grp_cad1,  groups),
  "Step–30-min cadence (between)"                      = corr_subset(acor, grp_step,  grp_cad30, groups),
  "Step–DHRPS (between)"                               = corr_subset(acor, grp_step,  grp_dhrps, groups),
  "1-min cadence–30-min cadence (between)"             = corr_subset(acor, grp_cad1,  grp_cad30, groups),
  "1-min cadence–DHRPS (between)"                      = corr_subset(acor, grp_cad1,  grp_dhrps, groups),
  "30-min cadence–DHRPS (between)"                     = corr_subset(acor, grp_cad30, grp_dhrps, groups),

  # Each metric group vs all others
  "Step count vs all others"                           = corr_vs_others(acor, grp_step,  groups),
  "1-min cadence vs all others"                        = corr_vs_others(acor, grp_cad1,  groups),
  "30-min cadence vs all others"                       = corr_vs_others(acor, grp_cad30, groups),
  "DHRPS vs all others"                                = corr_vs_others(acor, grp_dhrps, groups),

  # Time horizons vs all others
  "Year vs all others"                                 = time_vs_others(acor, time_year,  time_groups),
  "Six Months vs all others"                           = time_vs_others(acor, time_six,   time_groups),
  "Month vs all others"                                = time_vs_others(acor, time_month, time_groups),
  "Week vs all others"                                 = time_vs_others(acor, time_week,  time_groups),
  "Day vs all others"                                  = time_vs_others(acor, time_day,   time_groups)
)

# --- Assemble summary table ---
stab3 <- tibble(
  comparison     = names(comparisons),
  `median (IQR)` = map_chr(comparisons, summ_median_iqr)
)

# View
stab3
```

# Supplementary Data

## Supplementary Data 1

```{r}
# --------------------------- Setup -------------------------------------------
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(openxlsx)

# Exposures, time scales, and pretty labels
exposures   <- c("steps", "cadence1", "cadence30", "dhrps")
time_scales <- c("year", "six", "month", "week", "day")
time_labels <- c(year = "year", six = "six", month = "month", week = "week", day = "day")

# Optional: provide median follow-up time per time scale (replace NAs if you have values)
median_follow_up <- c(year = NA, six = NA, month = NA, week = NA, day = NA)

# Vectorized formatter: "x.xx (l.ll–h.hh)"
fmt_effect <- function(est, low, high, digits = 2) {
  est  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(est))
  low  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(low))
  high <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(high))
  n <- max(length(est), length(low), length(high))
  if (n == 0) return(character())
  out <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  ok  <- !is.na(est) & !is.na(low) & !is.na(high)
  if (any(ok)) {
    fmt <- paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f–%." , digits, "f)")
    out[ok] <- sprintf(fmt, est[ok], low[ok], high[ok])
  }
  out
}

# --------------------- Core builder for one time scale -----------------------
build_table_for_scale <- function(scale) {
  # --- Pull Cox pieces for each exposure
  cox_list <- map(exposures, function(exp) {
    obj_name <- paste0("cox_", scale, "_", exp)
    if (!exists(obj_name, inherits = TRUE)) {
      stop("Missing object: ", obj_name)
    }
    df <- get(obj_name, inherits = TRUE)

    out <- df %>%
      transmute(
        phecode_string,
        phecode,
        !!paste0("HR_", exp) := fmt_effect(hazard_ratio, hazard_ratio_low, hazard_ratio_high),
        !!paste0("p_cox_", exp) := as.numeric(p_value)
      )

    out_cases <- df %>%
      select(phecode_string, phecode, cases) %>%
      distinct()

    list(results = out, cases = out_cases)
  })

  # Merge all Cox HR columns
  cox_merged <- reduce(map(cox_list, "results"),
                       ~ full_join(.x, .y, by = c("phecode_string", "phecode")))

  # Pick a single Cox cases column (prefer from steps)
  if (exists(paste0("cox_", scale, "_steps"), inherits = TRUE)) {
    cox_cases <- get(paste0("cox_", scale, "_steps")) %>%
      select(phecode_string, phecode, `# of cases (Cox)` = cases) %>%
      distinct()
  } else {
    cox_cases <- map(cox_list, "cases") %>%
      compact() %>%
      reduce(~ full_join(.x, .y, by = c("phecode_string", "phecode"))) %>%
      mutate(`# of cases (Cox)` = coalesce(!!!rlang::syms(setdiff(names(.), c("phecode_string","phecode"))))) %>%
      select(phecode_string, phecode, `# of cases (Cox)`)
  }

  # --- Pull logistic pieces for each exposure
  logistic_list <- map(exposures, function(exp) {
    obj_name <- paste0("logistic_", scale, "_", exp)
    if (!exists(obj_name, inherits = TRUE)) {
      stop("Missing object: ", obj_name)
    }
    df <- get(obj_name, inherits = TRUE)

    # CI bounds are given on log-odds scale -> exponentiate to OR scale
    # keep NA propagation: if either conf_int is NA, CI stays NA
    ci_low_log  <- pmin(df$conf_int_1, df$conf_int_2)
    ci_high_log <- pmax(df$conf_int_1, df$conf_int_2)
    ci_low  <- exp(ci_low_log)
    ci_high <- exp(ci_high_log)

    out <- df %>%
      transmute(
        phecode_string,
        phecode,
        !!paste0("OR_", exp) := fmt_effect(odds_ratio, ci_low, ci_high),
        !!paste0("p_logistic_", exp) := as.numeric(p_value)
      )

    out_cases <- df %>%
      select(phecode_string, phecode, cases) %>%
      distinct()

    list(results = out, cases = out_cases)
  })

  # Merge all logistic OR columns
  logistic_merged <- reduce(map(logistic_list, "results"),
                      ~ full_join(.x, .y, by = c("phecode_string", "phecode")))

  # Pick logistic cases (prefer from steps)
  if (exists(paste0("logistic_", scale, "_steps"), inherits = TRUE)) {
    logistic_cases <- get(paste0("logistic_", scale, "_steps")) %>%
      select(phecode_string, phecode, `# of cases (logistic)` = cases) %>%
      distinct()
  } else {
    logistic_cases <- map(logistic_list, "cases") %>%
      compact() %>%
      reduce(~ full_join(.x, .y, by = c("phecode_string", "phecode"))) %>%
      mutate(`# of cases (logistic)` = coalesce(!!!rlang::syms(setdiff(names(.), c("phecode_string","phecode"))))) %>%
      select(phecode_string, phecode, `# of cases (logistic)`)
  }

  # --- Compose final table for this time scale
  base <- full_join(cox_merged, cox_cases, by = c("phecode_string", "phecode")) %>%
          full_join(logistic_merged, by = c("phecode_string", "phecode")) %>%
          full_join(logistic_cases, by = c("phecode_string", "phecode"))

  # Add median follow-up time (single value per time scale)
  base <- base %>%
    mutate(`median follow-up time` = median_follow_up[[ time_labels[[scale]] ]])

  # Reorder columns per your spec
  hr_cols   <- paste0("HR_", exposures)
  or_cols   <- paste0("OR_", exposures)
  p_cox_cols <- paste0("p_cox_", exposures)
  p_logistic_cols  <- paste0("p_logistic_", exposures)

  base <- base %>%
    select(
      phecode_string, phecode,
      all_of(hr_cols), `# of cases (Cox)`, `median follow-up time`,
      all_of(or_cols), `# of cases (logistic)`,
      all_of(p_cox_cols), all_of(p_logistic_cols)  # keep for styling; not written
    ) %>%
    arrange(phecode_string, phecode)

  # Bonferroni threshold for this sheet
  n_rows <- nrow(base)
  bonf <- ifelse(n_rows > 0, 0.05 / n_rows, NA_real_)

  list(data = base, bonf = bonf,
       hr_cols = hr_cols, or_cols = or_cols,
       p_cox_cols = p_cox_cols, p_logistic_cols = p_logistic_cols)
}

# ------------------------- Build all tables ----------------------------------
tables <- set_names(time_scales, time_scales) %>%
  map(build_table_for_scale)

# --------------------------- Write to Excel ----------------------------------
wb <- createWorkbook()
bold_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "left")

for (scale in time_scales) {
  tb <- tables[[scale]]
  df <- tb$data

  # Drop p-value helpers before writing
  write_df <- df %>%
    select(-all_of(tb$p_cox_cols), -all_of(tb$p_logistic_cols))

  sheet_name <- time_labels[[scale]]
  addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = write_df, withFilter = TRUE)

  # Bold HR cells that pass Bonferroni
  for (i in seq_along(tb$hr_cols)) {
    hr_col <- tb$hr_cols[i]
    p_col  <- tb$p_cox_cols[i]
    if (!(hr_col %in% names(df)) || !(p_col %in% names(df))) next
    sig_rows <- which(!is.na(df[[p_col]]) & df[[p_col]] < tb$bonf)
    if (length(sig_rows)) {
      col_index <- which(names(write_df) == hr_col)
      addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, style = bold_style,
               rows = sig_rows + 1, cols = col_index, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
    }
  }

  # Bold OR cells that pass Bonferroni
  for (i in seq_along(tb$or_cols)) {
    or_col <- tb$or_cols[i]
    p_col  <- tb$p_logistic_cols[i]
    if (!(or_col %in% names(df)) || !(p_col %in% names(df))) next
    sig_rows <- which(!is.na(df[[p_col]]) & df[[p_col]] < tb$bonf)
    if (length(sig_rows)) {
      col_index <- which(names(write_df) == or_col)
      addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, style = bold_style,
               rows = sig_rows + 1, cols = col_index, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
    }
  }

  freezePane(wb, sheet = sheet_name, firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(write_df), widths = "auto")
}

# Save workbook
saveWorkbook(wb, file = "phecode_summary_by_timescale.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

# ----------------------------- End of script ---------------------------------
```

## Supplementary Data 2

```{r}
# install.packages("writexl")  # if you don't have it
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)

# ===================== CONFIG =====================
alpha        <- 0.05
pcol         <- "p_value"                 # p-value column
codecol      <- "phecode"                 # unique phecode ID column
string_cands <- c("phecode_string","phenotype","description","phewas_string")

period_keys   <- c("day","week","month","six","year")
period_labels <- c(day="Day", week="Week", month="Month", six="Six months", year="Year")

variables <- c("steps","cadence1","cadence30","dhrps")
models    <- c("logistic","cox")

out_file  <- "phecode_significant_presence.xlsx"  # output Excel filename
# ==================================================

# Helper: pull significant rows (ID + string) for one (model, period, variable)
sig_rows <- function(model, period, variable) {
  obj <- paste(model, period, variable, sep = "_")  # e.g., "logistic_day_steps"
  if (!exists(obj, inherits = TRUE)) stop("Missing object: ", obj)
  df <- get(obj, inherits = TRUE)
  if (!all(c(pcol, codecol) %in% names(df))) {
    stop(sprintf("'%s' is missing required column(s): %s",
                 obj, paste(setdiff(c(pcol, codecol), names(df)), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  # pick a readable-string column if present
  stringcol <- intersect(string_cands, names(df))
  stringcol <- if (length(stringcol)) stringcol[1] else NA_character_

  thr <- if (nrow(df) > 0) alpha / nrow(df) else Inf

  sig <- df %>% filter(.data[[pcol]] < thr)
  out <- tibble(
    code   = as.character(sig[[codecol]]),
    string = if (!is.na(stringcol)) as.character(sig[[stringcol]]) else NA_character_
  ) %>% distinct()
  out
}

# Build one presence table for (model, variable)
build_presence_table <- function(model, variable) {
  # get significant codes + labels for each period
  sig_list <- lapply(period_keys, function(per) {
    s <- sig_rows(model, per, variable)
    s$period <- unname(period_labels[per])
    s
  })
  names(sig_list) <- unname(period_labels[period_keys])

  # union of all significant codes across periods
  all_codes <- unique(unlist(lapply(sig_list, `[[`, "code"), use.names = FALSE))

  # empty case: return 0-row df with the right columns
  if (length(all_codes) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      phecode_string = character(),
      `Day` = character(),
      `Week` = character(),
      `Month` = character(),
      `Six months` = character(),
      `Year` = character()
    ))
  }

  # best available label per code (first non-NA seen)
  label_df <- bind_rows(sig_list) %>%
    arrange(!is.na(string)) %>%
    group_by(code) %>%
    summarize(phecode_string = dplyr::first(na.omit(string)), .groups = "drop")

  # if label is missing, fall back to the code itself
  label_df$phecode_string[is.na(label_df$phecode_string)] <- label_df$code

  # start output with the label column, in alphabetical order
  base <- label_df %>%
    filter(code %in% all_codes) %>%
    arrange(phecode_string)

  # add "X" columns per period
  out <- tibble(phecode_string = base$phecode_string)
  for (nm in names(sig_list)) {
    codes_here <- sig_list[[nm]]$code
    out[[nm]] <- ifelse(base$code %in% codes_here, "X", "")
  }

  # ensure the column order is exactly requested
  out <- out %>%
    select(phecode_string,
           `Day`, `Week`, `Month`, `Six months`, `Year`)
  out
}

# Build all 8 sheets
sheets <- list()
for (m in models) {
  for (v in variables) {
    sheet_name <- paste(toupper(m), v, sep = "_")         # e.g., "logistic_steps"
    sheets[[sheet_name]] <- build_presence_table(m, v)
  }
}

# Write one Excel file with 8 sheets
writexl::write_xlsx(sheets, path = out_file)

message("Wrote: ", normalizePath(out_file))
```
